name: AppUi::Avatar
description: The round picture of a user (person or agent) in the standard sizes, with initials on a generated per-user background for a person without image and a robot marker for an agent.

size.description: xs (20px), s (30px, alias sm), m (40px, default) or l (96px); unknown values give m

id.description: The user image address and agent lookup

name.description: The image address, the agent lookup and the key of the generated background

profilePicture.description: The agent picture; without one the agent shows the robot icon
